scope_note: Covers this repository's own real published capabilities (capabilities/*/*/*/contract.json). traverse-framework/traverse#899's own inventory (contracts/governance/ecca-capability-inventory.json in that repo) covers a different, unrelated set of artifacts under that repo's contracts/examples/ and contracts/inference/ trees -- despite some capability_id values coincidentally matching, they are not the same content and #899 does not satisfy Spec 534 FR-020 for this repository's catalog. Regenerated 2026-08-10 for registry#253 so every published capability ID is classified; CI now fails if inventory coverage drifts.

Status transitions are domain facts independent consumers may observe. registry#324: the previously governed event core.action-item.status-transitioned violated traverse-contracts' own EventContract identity invariant (id must equal namespace + "." + name) and is now deprecated (both 1.0.0/1.0.1); replaced by core.status-transitioned@1.0.0, publishers=[core.transition-action-status@1.4.0]. Capability contract 1.4.0 declares emits=[{event_id: core.status-transitioned, version: 1.0.0}], service_type=subscribable, requires action_item_id, and the WASM guest actually calls traverse_host::emit_event on accepted transitions (reason_code=ok) with payload {action_item_id, from_status, to_status, actor_id} — real emit, not declaration-only. Immutable prior versions: 1.0.0/1.1.0 empty emits[]; 1.2.0/1.3.0 now deprecated (emitted the identity-invariant-violating event id).
